The equation $y=50x+120$ gives the total amount $y$, in dollars, the cable company charges for $x$ months of cable service. Which of the following represents the amount, in dollars, of the wireless installation fee the cable company charges new customers?

questions.stem: A circle has a circumference of 28 centimeters. What is the diameter, in centimeters, of the circle, rounded to the nearest hundredth?

Which of the following equations represents this model, where $N$ is the estimated number of squirrels in this area $t$ years after $2003$, and $0\le t\le20$?
